reference_candidates.review: Read complete main.py and router.py; pure JSON action data; only local sibling-file reads and documented environment toggles. No network or shell calls. No agent execution performed in this review.
reference_candidates.strategic_difference: 13 whole-season action programs selected using first two public shops at step 144; per-worker same-day weed repair queues; planned-sale advances; clone-gated six-turn sale advance; idle WATER/CARE; guarded opening and final liquidation.
